items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, Tony Jackson, the first time I heard it, that's what he was singing. He sang that here at the Deluxe.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was published. I have the music for it. Yeah, yeah. But there was another name they used for it, too, and I forget that name, too.
Well, Tony Jackson, the first time I heard it, that's what he was singing. He sang that here at the Deluxe.
You know it's good for people to think of those things when you can't think now. Who would ever think of Tony Jackson, all of them?
